data.one_liner: Animated icons for Flutter based on Lucide without Rive or Lottie
data.what_it_does: Provides 700+ animated Flutter icons based on the Lucide icon set that support interactive touch and hover states. They feature built-in animations like rotation, scaling, path drawing, and morphing without requiring Rive or Lottie.
use_when: You want animated icons in your Flutter app based on the Lucide icon set.
You want hover or touch interaction on icons without writing custom animation controllers.
You want to avoid external heavy runtimes like Rive or Lottie for simple icon animations.
avoid_when: you need standard Material or Cupertino icons exclusively.
You require complex multi-character vector animations that demand Rive or Lottie.
strengths: Over 700 animated icons included out of the box.
Supports interactive touch and hover states automatically.
weaknesses: Limited to icons inspired by the Lucide icon set.

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a massive catalog of static Font Awesome icons instead of animated Lucide icons.
